title: Concrete mix design clarification
description: Requesting clarification on concrete mix design for pier foundations. Specs call for 5000 PSI but site conditions may require higher strength due to saltwater exposure.

title: Electrical conduit routing through deck
description: Need routing plan for electrical conduits through the new bridge deck. Conflict with post-tensioning tendons at grid lines 4-7.
response_summary: Conduits rerouted to east side of deck. Updated drawings issued ASI-014.

title: Bearing pad material substitution
description: Specified elastomeric bearing pads (Fabreeka TIM-1000) have 16-week lead time. Requesting approval for equivalent product from Dynamic Isolation Systems.

title: Temporary shoring design for Phase 2
description: Need approval of temporary shoring design for Phase 2 deck removal. Proposed system uses steel H-piles with timber lagging.
response_summary: Approved with condition: add lateral bracing at 12-ft intervals per structural review.

title: Rebar splice locations at pier caps
description: Drawings show conflicting splice locations for #11 bars at pier cap P-3. Sheet S-401 shows mid-span, S-402 shows at support.

title: Foundation depth for underground parking
description: Geotechnical report indicates rock at 42 ft. Design shows excavation to 48 ft for 3-level parking. Need clarification on foundation bearing elevation.

title: HVAC ductwork routing on floors 15-20
description: Ductwork conflicts with structural beams at floors 15-20. Need revised routing or beam penetration approval.
response_summary: Approved beam penetrations at 6 locations per structural engineer review. See SK-M-042.

title: Curtain wall anchor bolt pattern revision
description: Manufacturer requires 6-bolt pattern instead of specified 4-bolt for wind load compliance at floors 20+. Need structural approval for revised embed plates.

title: Fire rating at parking garage ceiling
description: Code requires 2-hour fire rating at parking/occupied floor separation. Drawings show 1-hour assembly. Please confirm required rating.
response_summary: 2-hour rating confirmed per IBC 508.4. Revised assembly spec issued in ASI-008.

title: Elevator pit waterproofing system
description: High water table at site. Requesting approval for bentonite waterproofing system in lieu of specified membrane at elevator pits 1-4.

title: Pool filtration system specifications
description: Need specifications for the pool filtration and chemical treatment system. Design documents reference 'equal to Pentair IntelliChlor' but no detailed spec provided.
response_summary: Pentair IntelliChlor IC40 specified. Full spec issued in addendum 3.

title: Gymnasium floor material change
description: Requesting approval to change gymnasium floor from hardwood to synthetic sport surface (Mondo Ramflex). Cost savings of $45K and better maintenance profile.
response_summary: Approved. Mondo Ramflex 8mm in Sport Oak color accepted as substitution.

title: Roof drain location conflict with structure
description: Roof drain at grid B-4 conflicts with steel beam W21x50. Need relocation or beam modification.
response_summary: Drain relocated 3 ft east to grid B-4.5. Revised plumbing drawings issued.

title: Radiation shielding thickness at imaging suite
description: Physics report requires 1/8 inch lead equivalent shielding at all imaging room walls. Drawings show 1/16 inch at corridor walls. Please confirm required thickness.

title: Medical gas piping material specification
description: Specs reference ASTM B819 Type K copper for medical gas. Supplier recommends Type L for sizes above 2 inch. Need clarification on acceptable alternatives.

title: Pile driving vibration limits near existing buildings
description: Adjacent historic building (100 NW Naito) has vibration sensitivity. Need confirmed PPV limits and monitoring requirements during pile installation.
response_summary: PPV limit set at 0.5 in/sec. Continuous monitoring required within 50 ft. Pre-construction survey of adjacent building completed.

title: Residential unit sound transmission class
description: Code requires STC 50 between residential units. Current wall assembly tests at STC 47. Need approval for revised assembly or acceptance of current rating.

title: Asbestos abatement scope expansion
description: Additional ACM found in 2nd floor ceiling plenum not identified in original survey. Need revised abatement scope and schedule impact assessment.
response_summary: Revised abatement plan issued. 3-week schedule extension approved via CO-004.

title: Historic window replacement approval
description: SHPO requires review of window replacement design. Original wood windows to be replaced with aluminum-clad wood. Need confirmation of approved profile and muntin pattern.

title: Jet bridge connection point elevation
description: Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A321neo have different door sill heights. Need confirmed design elevation for fixed jet bridge connection points at gates C1-C12.

title: Membrane filtration system chemical compatibility
description: Proposed Pall MF membrane system requires specific cleaning chemicals. Need confirmation that chemical feed system design accommodates NaOCl and citric acid cleaning protocols.
